[Gentlemen](../others.html#248)
I am much obliged for [£10](../others.html#160) for the [publication](../others.html#172) of the [Modern Telemachus](../books.html#185) I am sending the receipt to [Mr Asgood](../persons.html#2367)
I remain &c

C M Yonge		
Messrs Harper

[^1]: The collection also includes a stamped receipt.
